controls_used.control: A pelican riding a bicycle. Click the pe

notes.b1/j1/F-r1: Detailed bike with chain and spokes and a clear pelican with pouched bill, though the body floats above the seat and the cadence slider works.
notes.b1/j1/Q-r1: Clean but small and simple pelican and bike, with a slightly detached look and a minimal control strip.
notes.b1/j1/A-r1: Nice hills and clouds and a wing reaching the handlebar with a bell, but the legs are thin and the layout leaves empty space.
notes.b1/j1/Q-r2: Teal bike and a pelican with a crest and a big wing, though the pedal and leg drawing looks awkward.
notes.b1/j1/A-r2: Charming pelican with a helmet and a clear pouch, a simple bike, and working speed, reverse and honk controls with a distance counter.
notes.b1/j1/F-r2: Richest scene with a chain, a crate cargo bike, posts and good leg motion, but the added cargo crate goes beyond the plain request.
notes.b1/j2/Q-r2: Clear pelican with pouch and teal bike, but the wing lies flat like a blanket and the leg and pedal geometry is clumsy.
notes.b1/j2/A-r2: Big expressive pelican with a helmet on a red bike, with parallax scenery, a distance counter and a reverse control, though the leg looks a little thin.
notes.b1/j2/F-r2: Richly detailed pelican on a cargo bike with chain, basket, bell and a good responsive layout, though the basket is an embellishment.
notes.b1/j2/A-r1: Recognizable pelican on a red bike, but the legs are stiff, the pelican is small on mobile and the cloud overlaps the sun.
notes.b1/j2/Q-r1: Clean flat style with a good beak, but the bike is simple and the pelican looks perched rather than gripping the bars.
notes.b1/j2/F-r1: Best bike, with chainring, chain and drop bars, plus a convincing pelican with a gradient pouch, a pause control and a cadence slider.
notes.b1/j3/A-r2: Cheerful scene and helmet, but the bulky body sits awkwardly on the frame and the wing floats like a flat slab.
notes.b1/j3/F-r2: Polished cargo-bike scene with detailed chain, crate and fish, though the cargo bike is an embellishment and the pelican's long thin neck is a bit odd.
notes.b1/j3/Q-r2: Clear pelican with big pouch on a proper bike, pedalling legs reach the pedals and controls work.
notes.b1/j3/F-r1: Most convincing pelican with an expressive pouch, seated on a detailed bike with chain and gears and a well-drawn scene.
notes.b1/j3/A-r1: Pelican reads well but the legs look stiff and straight and the wheels are bare, and the pelican sits oddly high.
notes.b1/j3/Q-r1: Clean, simple pelican and bike with working pause and speed, but the pelican floats a bit above the bike and the wheels are small.
notes.b2/j1/F-r3: Large, readable pelican with arm on the handlebar, pedalling legs, chain and scrolling scenery, with clear controls and a good mobile layout.
notes.b2/j1/Q-r3: Pleasant scenery but the pelican is small, the wing is a stiff slab not gripping the bars, and the status label floats oddly.
notes.b2/j1/A-r3: Charming helmeted pelican with a clear pouch and pedalling legs, plus honk and reverse, though the stats line is tiny.
notes.b2/j1/Q-r4: Polished helmeted pelican on a bike with a clean scene and controls, but the bird and bike are somewhat small in the frame.
notes.b2/j1/A-r4: Solid pelican and bike with night mode, but the body hovers above the frame and the mid-ground band looks muddy.
notes.b2/j1/F-r4: Clean, correct and usable with clear controls, but the scene is sparse and the pelican wing looks clumsy.
notes.b2/j2/Q-r4: Charming helmeted pelican with a clear pouch, spinning spokes and a scrolling scene, though the ring-bell checkbox is an odd control.
notes.b2/j2/A-r4: Readable pelican with night mode and reverse, but the body floats above the frame and the legs look thin and awkward.
notes.b2/j2/F-r4: Clean and correct with a grey wing, but the scene is sparse with a washed-out sky and a small pelican.
notes.b2/j2/A-r3: Vivid, well-posed pelican with a helmet, a wing on the handlebar and good hills, and a useful status readout.
notes.b2/j2/Q-r3: Nice scenery with trees and the pelican's feet on the pedals, but the wing is a flat grey slab and the controls are minimal.
notes.b2/j2/F-r3: Largest and most convincing rider, with a wing gripping the handlebar, a chain, a sunset gradient and a ding bubble, and it adapts well to a phone.
notes.b2/j3/A-r4: Clear pelican with pouch bill and helmet on a bike with many controls, but the body floats above the frame and the legs look disconnected.
notes.b2/j3/F-r4: Clean, readable pelican with chain and bell, but a sparse scene and slightly awkward leg and foot placement.
notes.b2/j3/Q-r4: Charming helmeted pelican with trees and hills and a wing reaching the bars; controls are minimal and the ring-bell checkbox is a little odd.
notes.b2/j3/F-r3: Largest, most detailed pelican with wing on handlebars, chain, bell and a responsive layout; the most convincing rider.
notes.b2/j3/A-r3: Polished scene with a believable pedaling pose, honk bubble and a live status readout; the controls are well integrated.
notes.b2/j3/Q-r3: Pleasant scene, but the wing is a flat grey slab, the legs are awkward and the status label is vague.
